speaker: dad
igboText: Nwa m nwanyị, enweghị m ike hie ụra n'abalị ụnyaahụ.
englishText: My daughter, I couldn't sleep last night.
statement: Dad says he could not sleep last night.
falseStatement: Dad says he could not sleep last week.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks what he did.
falseStatement: The daughter asks what she did.

speaker: dad
englishText: I got up and cleaned the house.
statement: Dad says he got up and cleaned the house.
falseStatement: Dad says he got up and watered the plants.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks if he cleaned only the house.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if he cleaned the house and garden.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mba. Hichara m ime ụlọ, ụzọ, na windo.
englishText: No. I cleaned the room, door, and window.
statement: Dad says he cleaned the room, door, and window.
falseStatement: Dad says he cleaned the room, door, and ceiling.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks if there is anything else.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if there is anything missing.

speaker: dad
igboText: Hichara m oche, tebulu, akwa, na ohiri isi.
englishText: I cleaned the chair, table, bed, and pillow.
statement: Dad says he cleaned the chair, table, bed, and pillow.
falseStatement: Dad says he cleaned the chair, table, bed, and lamp.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter calls out to Dad.
falseStatement: The daughter calls out to Mom.

speaker: dad
englishText: I also swept the mat with a broom.
statement: Dad says he also swept the mat with a broom.
falseStatement: Dad says he also swept the floor with a broom.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks about the kitchen.
falseStatement: The daughter asks about the living room.

speaker: dad
igboText: Hichara m ite, ngaji, efere, iko, na bọketi.
englishText: I cleaned the pot, spoon, plate, cup, and bucket.
statement: Dad says he cleaned the pot, spoon, plate, cup, and bucket.
falseStatement: Dad says he cleaned the pot, spoon, bowl, cup, and bucket.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Chei! Ihe ndị ahụ niile bụ ihe m chọrọ ihicha taa!
englishText: Oh wow! Those are all the things I wanted to clean today!
statement: The daughter says those are all the things she wanted to clean today.
falseStatement: The daughter says those are all the things she wanted to cook today.
